items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: And this fellow Cantrell used to play.

ctx.x: Did he live across the river? Yeah he lived across the river. He worked over there most of the time? Yes, that's what he lived. And Feeder Father used to play with him.
And this fellow Cantrell used to play.
Yeah well his dad would play the drums.
